summary.headline: Native’s Being and First House
summary.text: Chapter X explains the native’s condition and the significations of the first house, using the three lords of the Ascendant’s triplicity to judge the beginning, middle, and end of life. It also describes Saturn’s effects in the Sun’s house and by trine or sextile to the Sun, including inheritance, wealth, illness, and fortune through high-ranking people.
